python3 - <<'PY'
import json,collections
rows=[json.loads(x) for x in open('items.jsonl')];a=[json.loads(x) for x in open('answers.jsonl')]
cs=['ъьъъ','ъьъ','ъъьъ','ьъ','ь','ъъ']
for r,c in zip(rows[len(a):],cs):a.append(dict(item_id=r['item_id'],slots={str(i):s for i,s in enumerate(c,1)},confidence={str(i):'high' for i in range(1,len(c)+1)},unmarked_final_hard_signs=[],pre1918='yes',note=''))
with open('answers.jsonl','w') as f:
 for x in a:f.write(json.dumps(x,ensure_ascii=False)+'\n')
assert len(a)==len(rows)
for r,x in zip(rows,a):
 assert x['item_id']==r['item_id']
 expected={str(i) for i in range(1,r['slots']+1)}
 assert set(x['slots'])==expected and set(x['confidence'])==expected
 assert all(v in ['ъ','ь','other','u'] for v in x['slots'].values())
 assert all(v in ['high','low'] for v in x['confidence'].values())
 assert x['pre1918'] in ['yes','no','unclear']
counts=collections.Counter(v for x in a for v in x['slots'].values())
print('Validated count, order, slot coverage:',len(a),'items;',sum(counts.values()),'slots')
print(dict(counts))
print('Items with unmarked final hard signs:',sum(bool(x['unmarked_final_hard_signs']) for x in a))
